chosen_on: 2025 practice races (18 dry races, backtest with only earlier data); the 2026 races were not used

scores.note: Brier skill vs grid-only baseline (positive = better than baseline); winner log-loss (grid baseline 1.125); 5,000 sims per race

without_weekend_info_m5.decision: no consistent gain from narrowing without qualifying information, so the full fitted spread (1.0) is kept

note: pace_spread_scale applies when this weekend's dry qualifying gaps are known; pace_spread_scale_without_quali otherwise (the website's own scenarios)
wet_driver_effects_note: Chosen on the wet-race backtest (13 wet races 2022-2026, each fitted on earlier races only; docs/backtest.md). With the measured driver wet effects the rain model scored worse than ignoring rain (rank correlation 0.557 vs 0.616, winner log-loss 1.92 vs 1.46); without them 0.620 and 1.43. The effects are measured only against team-mates, so long-standing pairs get equal and opposite values.
rival_switch_spread_note: W10, chosen on the wet-race backtest. Rival switch laps spread like real teams' (SD 1.1 laps, 23 transitions) made wet predictions slightly worse (rank correlation 0.615 vs 0.618 with a rain window, winner log-loss 1.49 vs 1.44; 1.57 vs 1.38 with the real conditions replayed), because the model punishes a late switch about 3-4 times harder than real races show (W3 slope is assumed, not fitted). Off until that slope is calibrated.

pace_blend.note: I2/I4 refitted on as-of priors (docs/assumptions.md); used by the website and the 2026 exam

pace_spread_note: Re-chosen 2026-11-22 after the independent review (the earlier 0.35 used a coverage check that counted discrete position ranges as 80% when they held about 93%). Chosen on 2024 + 2025 backtest races (36 races, as-of fits, 5,000 sims) by the mean log score of the actual finishing position (whole distribution) and the winner log score; both best at 0.7, which also puts 80% of outcomes inside the central 80% (randomised PIT: 80.8% in 2024, 79.6% in 2025). Scale without qualifying (website, before qualifying) unchanged at 1.0, not re-tested.

spread_scan_2024_2025.metric: position log score 2024 / 2025; winner log score 2024 / 2025; PIT central-80 2024 / 2025

pass_logit_shift_note: O3, tested 2026-11-22 on the 2024 races: shifts of 0 to +2 on the pass model's log-odds changed the finishing-order and position scores only within noise, and the simulated grid-to-finish rank correlation already matched the real one (0.808 vs 0.803). Kept at 0: the fitted pass model stands.
